stations.title: Luka
stations.say: Can I get the list of boats?

captions: At Larchmere Kayaks, Luka needs the list of boats for his booking page.
The server starts, but no route answers, so every request fails.
You write the routes and the JSON answers, in three tasks.
Now GET /boats answers with the whole fleet as JSON.
Same request, a real answer. And a clear no for anything else.
